title: Mid-pattern `*` in `git -C * SUBCMD*` read-only entries matches write commands that end in the subcommand name

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-185558-0ab6 for S575. The `git -C * SUBCMD*` read-only entries let `*` span the subcommand. `Bash(git -C * show*)` matches `git -C /w commit -m show`, and `Bash(git -C * merge-base*)` matches `git -C /w commit -m merge-base`. The same holds for diff, log, status and ls-files, and for the implementer's `git -C * mv*` and `git -C * rm *`.

The match is confirmed for ork's own matcher. `wildcard` in `internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:427-432` turns `*` into `.*`, so a claude-local role's hook allows these write commands. The model in `internal/engine/perm_test.go:18-28` does the same. The real Claude Code CLI was not probed (see the `[HUMAN CHECK]` in Check). The owner decided pin-path-all (adj 577, `launch.read-only-git-c-form`). Every `git -C` entry takes the role's worktree path and becomes `Bash(git -C PATH SUBCMD*)`, so no write command ending in the subcommand name can match. This slice also covers S585: the permission tests check every `git -C * X*` entry against a fixed list of git write commands whose last argument is X.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-25: adj 577 (pin path for every git -C entry), adj 579 (pin at launch in rolePermission), adj 580 (an unpinnable path drops the git -C entries).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
All in package `engine` unless noted. The worktree in these tests is `/w`.
- TestReadOnlyAllowlistRefusesGitWritesEndingInASubcommand (`perm_test.go`, new): for `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist("/w")` and `CloudUIAllowlist("/w")`, each X in diff, log, status, show, ls-files, merge-base, and each write in `git -C /w commit -m X`, `git -C /w push origin X`, `git -C /w checkout X`, `git -C /w reset --hard X`, `git -C /w branch -D X` and `git -C /w tag X`, no entry matches (`allowlistMatches`). Today the `git -C * X*` entries match them.
- TestReadOnlyAllowlistPinsGitCToTheWorktree (`perm_test.go`, new): `git -C /w status`, `git -C /w show HEAD:f` and `git -C /w merge-base main HEAD` match an entry. `git -C /other status` and `git -C /w/sub status` match none. No entry holds `git -C *`.
- TestImplementerGitCEntriesRefuseWritesEndingInASubcommand (`perm_test.go`, new): for the go and python presets passed through `PinGitC(list, "/w")`, each X in status, diff, log, ls-files, mv, rm and the same write commands (`git -C /w commit -m X` and the rest), no entry matches. `git -C /w status`, `git -C /w mv a b` and `git -C /w rm f` do match. This is the S585 check.
- TestPinGitC (`perm_test.go`, new):
  - It rewrites `Bash(git -C * status*)` to `Bash(git -C /w status*)` and `Bash(git -C * rm *)` to `Bash(git -C /w rm *)`.
  - It leaves `Bash(go -C * test*)`, `Bash(git status*)` and `Read` as they are.
  - It returns a slice of its own.
  - A worktree that is empty, relative, or contains a space, `*`, `,`, a quote or a parenthesis drops every `git -C *` entry and keeps the rest.
- TestAllowlistMatchesModel (`perm_test.go`, add a case): `Bash(git -C * show*)` matches `git -C /w commit -m show`, which documents why the pin is needed.
- TestRolePermissionPinsGitCForImplementerAndPart (`perm_test.go`, new): `rolePermission` gives the implementer and a part `git -C REC.WORKTREE ...` entries, with or without grants. A grant pattern is added as written. A read-only role gets no allowlist.
- Existing tests that change:
  - TestReadOnlyAllowlistBatch, TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesAdjLint, TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesSlicerCheck, TestReadOnlyAllowlistMatchesNoTrackingWrite and TestReadOnlyAllowlistIncludesMergeBase call the lists with a worktree. They expect `Bash(git -C /w ls-files*)` and `Bash(git -C /w merge-base*)`.
  - TestHappyPathReachesAwaitingApproval (`engine_test.go:322`) and TestRetryAllowReachesAResumedStoppedRun (`stoppedresume_test.go:184`) expect the implementer allowlist to equal `PinGitC(DefaultImplementerAllowlist(...), worktree)`.
  - TestCloudUIPassDoneWhenListsItsAllowedForms (`brief_test.go`) uses `CloudUIAllowlist(in.Worktree)`, and its Allowed forms line holds no `git -C *`.
- TestClaudeRunnerPinsReadOnlyGitCToTheWorktree (`internal/daemon/runner_test.go`, new): a read-only request with `Worktree: "/work"` gives the `claude.Spec` an allowlist with `Bash(git -C /work status*)` and none containing `git -C *`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In `internal/engine/perm.go` add `PinGitC(list []string, worktree string) []string`. It returns a new slice. It replaces the `*` in each entry that starts `Bash(git -C * ` with the worktree path. It copies every other entry unchanged. The worktree is usable only when it is absolute and `ShellWord(worktree) == worktree`. That rules out a space, `*`, quotes, parentheses, and `,`, which would split the `--allowedTools` list in `internal/agent/claude/args.go:150`. When it is not usable, drop every `git -C *` entry (see Owner needed).
2. Rename the body of `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` to an unexported base list. Make `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist(worktree string)` return `PinGitC(base, worktree)`. Make `CloudUIAllowlist(worktree string)` return `append(LocalReadOnlyAllowlist(worktree), "Skill")`. Update the doc comments to cite adj 577 and `launch.read-only-git-c-form`.
3. In `rolePermission` pin the implementer's and a part's resolved allowlist with `PinGitC(perm.Allow, rec.Worktree)` before `mergeGrants`, and also when the run has no grants. Restructure the early return so it still skips read-only roles and other roles. `ResolvePermission`, `ImplementerPreset` and `DefaultImplementerAllowlist` keep their signatures and still return `git -C *` entries. The registry stores the preset and hand-written lists, and `projects set` and the settings views show them, so there the entries stay a template. Grants from `ork retry --allow` are not rewritten.
4. In `internal/daemon/runner.go` pass `req.Worktree` to `LocalReadOnlyAllowlist` (line 42) and `CloudUIAllowlist` (line 51).
5. In `internal/engine/brief.go:353` call `CloudUIAllowlist(in.Worktree)`, so the brief names the list the runner sends.
6. Write the tests listed under Failing tests. Update the existing callers.
7. Update `docs/design.md` at lines 2566-2570 and 2689-2701. The read-only list and the implementer entries are pinned to the role's worktree at launch. The registry keeps the `git -C *` template.
8. Run `slicer changelog add S586 --text "..."`. Do not edit `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run 'TestReadOnlyAllowlist|TestImplementerGitC|TestPinGitC|TestAllowlistMatchesModel|TestRolePermission|TestCloudUIPass|TestHappyPath|TestRetryAllow'` passes.
- `go test ./internal/daemon -run TestClaudeRunnerPinsReadOnlyGitCToTheWorktree` passes.
- `go test ./...` passes.
- `go vet ./...` is silent.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` passes.
- [HUMAN CHECK] Probe the real Claude Code matcher (not run by this draft). In a scratch git repo, start Claude Code with the allow rule Bash(git -C * show*) and ask it to run git -C /scratch commit --allow-empty -m show. If it runs without a prompt, the CLI's * spans the subcommand like ork's hook does. Then repeat with Bash(git -C /scratch show*): the commit command should prompt or be denied, and git -C /scratch show HEAD should run. Record the result on S586.
